episodes.title: Refined Aggression
probes: A British officer serving with UN peacekeepers on the Turkey–Syria border is abruptly summoned home to England.
A wealthy outside investor tours the grand country estate, taking a keen interest in its cellar of vintage wine.

episodes.title: Tackle Tommy Woo Woo
probes: Eddie is driven out to visit Susie's father, held in an oddly luxurious open-air prison.
Eddie, in black tie and clearly not enjoying himself, attends a lavish gala hosted by Johnston.

episodes.title: Where's My Weed At?
probes: Eddie sneaks into a chop shop at night, tasked with stealing a Lamborghini Huracan from among the dismantled cars.
Susie takes on a favour for an Albanian gang boss annoyed that his weed shipment has not arrived.
Eddie's mother frets about the family's slide into criminality, while Susie remarks how calm he stays under fire.

episodes.title: An Unsympathetic Gentleman
probes: Jimmy, thoroughly smitten, gives Gabrielle a proud personal tour around the underground farm.

episodes.title: I've Hundreds of Cousins
probes: Eddie and Susie drive out to a Travellers' camp to speak with the family's leader about two missing generators.
Two generators vanish from the weed farm, and Susie needs Eddie's help sorting out who took them.
The Belgian who runs the shipping side of the Glass distribution starts pushing for a bigger cut.

episodes.title: All Eventualities
probes: At a glitzy boxing party, Eddie falls into conversation with a smooth ex-army officer who promotes fighters.
Susie tells Eddie the money still needs another three months of laundering before it counts as clean profit.

episodes.title: Not Without Danger
probes: Eddie and Freddy pay a call on an ageing lord, a former associate of the Glasses, at his crumbling pile.

episodes.title: The Gospel According to Bobby Glass
probes: Lady Sabrina adds her own quiet encouragement when Susie is hesitating, pressing her gently rather than arguing.
Armed Glass men arrive in numbers at Halstead Manor and take up positions around the house and grounds.

episodes.title: The Road to Kingdom
probes: Susie sees off rival bidders in a drawn-out auction house battle over a Renaissance painting.
Bobby insists a visiting spirit told him to buy the painting, and Eddie quietly worries about his state of mind.
Eddie hosts a country shoot where the guests include an Italian countess and a politically connected peer.

episodes.title: There's a Rat in the Kitchen
probes: Hawthorne grumbles that Jack paid him hardly any attention during their night out together.
Eddie and Geoff go out hunting for a bookkeeper who has been skimming money from Moretti's accounts.
Lady Sabrina and Charly pay Freddy a visit at the rehabilitation facility where he is staying.

episodes.title: Do You Reject Satan?
probes: Workers at the weed farm down tools and go on strike, complaining about their working conditions.
Jimmy has been growing an experimental batch of weed that leaves people in a state of mania.
Eddie is fixated on buying back the acres the Horniman family lost generations ago, starting with a neighbour's estate.

episodes.title: The Bigger Picture
probes: The scheme depends on tracking down a valuable breeding Saker falcon, and Bella turns out to know falconry.
Eddie courts a bishop's vote by sorting out her son's debts to an Irish mobster.
Eddie watches uneasily as Joe is mocked and humiliated by people who knew him before.

episodes.title: A Suburban A-Road on the Outskirts of Basingstoke
probes: Susie and Joe fly out to Peru to talk to a cocaine producer about expanding into the UK.
In Peru, Susie and Joe get cocaine production running in the back rooms of a restaurant.

episodes.title: The Bells of San Domenico
probes: Bella marches Eddie into a church to confess to a priest, and he picks apart the whole process.
Moretti's consigliere pitches Eddie alternative money laundering methods, and he is thoroughly irked by her.
At the lakeside pre-wedding party, a former pursuer of Bella's corners her and won't leave her alone.

episodes.title: This Mad Circus
probes: Nanny is cool and dismissive towards Geoff, treating him with an offhandedness that clearly stings the old gamekeeper.
In the middle of the night the big house loses its power, and the internet goes down with it.
Geoff walks the dark woods of the estate alongside the gamekeeper from the neighbouring land.

episodes.title: Bring Me the Head
probes: Johnston talks to Eddie about turning his hardships into motivation, urging him towards something like king-like status.
